name: Santa Cruz de Lorica (Colombia)
description: Vertical tricolour of yellow, white and light blue, the white charged with a light blue disc bearing a yellow tower and eagle.
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cruz de Lorica, a municipality in the department of Córdoba, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: tower topped by an eagle on the disc
